sentences.text: Integrated Pest Management Demonstration Cum Training

**Scheme Brief Description:** The “Integrated Pest Management Demonstration Cum Training” scheme provides financial assistance for 30 farmers to conduct pest management demonstrations and training using a cluster approach in Farmer Field Schools.
**Who is this for:** Individual, University / Institution; Category: Agriculture,Rural & Environment; Sector: Financial assistance
**Where it applies:** Tamil Nadu; State/ UT

**Detailed Description:** The “Integrated Pest Management Demonstration Cum Training” scheme by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare Department, Tamil Nadu, supports pest management practices through demonstrations and training in Farmer Field Schools. Financial assistance is granted for each 40-hectare demonstration and training cluster. The scheme aims to enhance pest control knowledge among farmers, helping them manage pests effectively while reducing reliance on chemical pesticides.

**Benefits / Assistance:** - **For Farmer Field Schools:** Financial Assistance: Grants of ₹17,000/- is allowed towards Demonstration of 40 Ha. each and Training per Farmers Field School through cluster approach. - **For Farmers:** Training &amp; Demonstration: Hands-on training in pest management through Farmer Field Schools.

**Application Process:** **Step 1:** Collect the application form from the nearest Agricultural Office. **Step 2:** Fill out the application form with the required details and attach mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the form to the concerned office: > **Village Level:** Submit the application to the Assistant Agricultural Officer. > **Block Level:** Submit to the Agricultural Officer or Deputy Agricultural Officer. > **District Level:** Submit to the Joint Director of Agriculture.
**Tags:** Agriculture, Farmer, Integrated Pest Management, Training
